title: Disable Defender RTP
name: disable-defender-rtp
warning: Requires Tamper Protection to be disabled in Windows Security first.
modal:
To disable Defender Real-Time Protection on Windows 10/11, you must first disable **Tamper Protection**:

1. Open **Windows Security** -> **Virus & threat protection**
2. Click **Manage settings** under 'Virus & threat protection settings'
3. Turn **Tamper Protection** to **Off**

Once Tamper Protection is Off, this tweak will disable Real-Time scanning. Note: This does not disable the entire Defender suite.
deepDescription: Disables Microsoft Defender Real-time Protection by setting `DisableRealtimeMonitoring` via `Set-MpPreference` and policy registry keys. Note: On Windows 10 (1903+) and Windows 11, Tamper Protection must be turned off manually in Windows Security settings beforehand, or Windows will block the modification.
